}

<|start_of_role|>available_tools<|end_of_role|>
{
    "type": "function",
    "function": {
        "name": "book_flight",
        "description": "Book a flight",
        "parameters": {
            "$defs": {
                "airport": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "pattern": "^[A-Z]{3}$"
                }
            },
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "from": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/airport"
                },
                "to": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/airport"
                },
                "passengers": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                            "name": {
                                "type": "string"
                            },
                            "age": {
                                "type": "integer"
                            }
                        },
                        "required": [
                            "name"
                        ]
                    }
                }
            },
            "required": [
                "from",
                "to"
            ]
        }
    }
}<|end_of_text|>
